movie.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look

comment.comment: So, we finally got to see a bit more of the long awaited GTA VI. I was expecting them to show just one mission or something small, but wow - so much content was packed into 26 minutes, and presented in a way that completely sold me on buying it. You can clearly see that many mechanics are borrowed from RDR2, but is that a bad thing? Absolutely not. It's actually great that they are building on something that has worked, and continues to work, so well. The environments, the driving, character progression, and the incredible attention to detail surrounding the main characters, etc., are all impressive. The game faced massively high expectations, and the developers promised something extraordinary. So, is there anything to nitpick? Sure. But despite that, does it all look amazing, and am I extremely excited to play it? Definitely. Great job, and I can't wait to see more.
